dataset.name: Categorical seven-floor stairwell stack from V9R continuity and the hypothetical V9T Floor 95 layer
dataset.scope: Preserve V8U through V9T, test Floors 93-99 against the V9R floor-band and transfer topology, and create separate low/base/high categorical stacks only where all three stairs are documented as continuing without a transfer event. Every Floor 95 placement and every cross-floor repetition remains hypothetical; no physical vertical scale, as-built geometry, mechanical property, damage result, solver or Blender use is authorized.

stack.stack_rule: Repeat each V9T low/base/high normalized landing placement as an explicitly hypothetical categorical placeholder only for V9R rows where the stair is present, service_status is CONTINUES and transfer_event is NONE.
stack.band_boundary_rule: Preserve every V9R floor-band label and boundary. A boundary without a listed transfer event permits categorical continuity only; it does not establish identical floor-specific geometry.
stack.scale_interpretation: The inherited 2.324597826 normalized pixels per published inch preserves relative V9T landing dimensions only and is not a physical conversion.
stack.zero_value_interpretation: Zero means no property or credit is assigned in V9U; it is not a claim that the real stairs had zero mass, stiffness, strength, connections or structural role.

evidence_policy.observed_or_transcribed_fact: V9R documents the three stairs as present and continuing on Floors 93-99, with no listed transfer event in the 21 floor/stair rows and with two published categorical bands separated between Floors 95 and 96.
evidence_policy.official_model_result: The floor bands and the Floor 95 overlay derive from NIST schematics or model figures; only Floor 95 has the labelled overlay used upstream, and none is an independent as-built measurement.
evidence_policy.archive_claim: No local-archive claim is used in V9U.
evidence_policy.model_hypothesis: The V9T low/base/high normalized rectangles are repeated unchanged as categorical placeholders at Floors 93-99.
evidence_policy.derived_result: Three separate 21-instance stacks, a 21-row continuity audit and six adjacent-level transition checks.
evidence_policy.contradiction_or_unknown: The 95-to-96 band boundary, exact floor-specific offsets, orientation changes, walls, doors, flights, stringers, connections, vertical spacing, as-built coordinates and damage remain unresolved.

next_iteration.objective: Preserve V8U through V9U and perform a cached-source-only sufficiency audit for any floor-specific stairwell plan or offset evidence on Floors 93-99 before any geometry is promoted beyond categorical placeholders. Keep low/base/high separate, retain zero mechanical and damage credit, and do not run Blender or a structural solver unless a later explicitly authorized objective changes those gates.
